title: Readie: Low-Latency Code Sandboxes for AI Agents
abstract: arXiv:2611.22171v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: From quantitative research to personal assistance, AI agents act by iteratively generating and executing code. To decouple the agent harness from code execution, many agents offload execution to dedicated systems called code sandboxes. However, existing code sandboxes suffer from slow startup. Whether they rely on custom snapshots or a single fat image, the root cause is the same: it is hard to build a compact, pre-warmed snapshot that can be shared across diverse agent-generated code while covering nearly all the artifacts (e.g., packages, datasets) it requires.   In this work, we propose learned startup snapshots for low-latency code sandboxes. Our insight is that while it is hard for a single snapshot to be both compact and cover most workloads, a set of snapshots can achieve both. translated_title: Readie：面向AI代理的低延迟代码沙箱
translated_abstract: 从量化研究到个人助理，AI代理通过迭代式地生成并执行代码来完成任务。为了将代理框架与代码执行解耦，许多代理将执行工作卸载到称为代码沙箱的专用系统中。然而，现有的代码沙箱存在启动缓慢的问题。无论它们依赖自定义快照还是单一的大型镜像，根本原因都是相同的：很难构建一个紧凑且预热的快照，既能在多样化的代理生成代码之间共享，又能覆盖其所需的几乎所有工件（例如软件包、数据集）。在这项工作中，我们提出了用于低延迟代码沙箱的学习型启动快照。我们的洞察是：虽然单个快照很难同时做到紧凑并覆盖大多数工作负载，但一组快照可以同时实现这两点。每个快照都很小、初始化迅速，并覆盖一部分代理生成的代码；这些快照组合在一起则能覆盖其中的大部分。我们从历史执行数据中学习这组快照……
tldr: 提出Readie系统，通过从历史执行中学习一组小型、快速初始化的启动快照集合，使其共同覆盖大部分AI代理生成的代码，从而解决现有代码沙箱启动缓慢的问题。
en_tdlr: Readie learns a set of compact, fast-initializing startup snapshots from past executions whose combination covers most agent-generated code, enabling low-latency code sandboxes for AI agents.
